authorization: 用户确认只有当前共享服务器；前瞻性固定窗口机制试验和自然工具端到端配对验证
inputs: byte-identical verified private tmpfs copies; retain pre/post hashes on every call; mlock inputs before preflight
outputs: own tmpfs; artifacts fsync before return; archive after all measurement; power-loss persistence not claimed
artifact_ids: session-local UUID5 of opaque fixed namespace, session key and compute ordinal; identical across policies; strict session registry validation
quality: same stage3b SYSTEM, strict final schema/artifact/reference/consumption; no posthoc normalization
failure_rule: stop entire experiment on first strict answer failure, window compute/delivery overrun, unexpected GPU tenant, worker disk I/O/major fault, source change, or generation cap. Retain all attempts; no prompt repairs or replacements.
host_scope: affinity is not exclusive reservation; never stop others or alter global THP/NUMA/page cache settings
scope: three known development parents; targeted replication of prior 3-session anomaly; not independent holdout or full matrix
primary_metric: natural real-tool submit-to-validated-answer JCT; controlled-window JCT reported separately and never claimed as natural acceleration
sentinels: one real three-tool group after model load and before each cycle; diagnostic only, all raw values retained; no hidden stability-based selection
tool_runtime: SHA256-verified tmpfs copy of pinned qwen-data-env site-packages; per-child PYTHONPATH fixed to this copy; mlock all copied files before warmup; system Python/stdlib remain host runtime
recipe_change: One numerical thread in every NumPy/SciPy/OpenMP pool; four logical CPUs cover two physical cores including their SMT siblings per tool. Different workload configuration from previous two-thread runs; do not pool their timings.
cpu_selection: Fixed from read-only 10-second per-CPU load/topology sample before new tool measurements; affinity is not reservation; other jobs remain unconstrained.
diagnostic: two warmups then three paired logistic two/one-thread comparisons in fixed AB/BA/AB order; choice of one thread is to remove BLAS helpers, not fastest mean selection
prior_preflights: both failed and retained; never relabelled or used as passed admission
design: Fixed-window results are conditional mechanism evidence. Natural phase retains real latency and all host noise; counterbalanced crossover, observational under shared CPU/memory bandwidth.

phases.name: fixed_window
phases.interpretation: real computations each call with fixed response budgets; conditional JCT only

phases.name: natural
phases.interpretation: actual unpadded tools; shared host observed, all six policy order permutations; repeats are not independent parents

local_resource_rule: selected GPUs exclusive to own engine PID; numerical workers read_bytes=0 and major_faults=0; parent per-batch read_bytes recorded; all model/runtime/input/protected-source pages locked; source/model-stat consistency checked
host_resource_rule: read-only covariates retained. Previous global-PSI stability gate not claimed passed; no host-exclusive natural causal claim. No sample rejection or reruns based on measured JCT.
model_residency: verified full tmpfs model plus pinned runtime and inputs; mlock byte limit checked before loading; abort if locking fails
